summary: Iteration 112 testing: OVC logos, forgot/reset password + endpoints, continue-watching, MyProfile watermark, card labels i18n. 7/8 backend tests pass (1 skipped because of a confirmed bug — see below). All frontend UI checks pass except Continue-Watching strips, which never render because the backend endpoint has a buggy filter.

critical.issue: Query filters posts by {video_url: {$ne: null}} (posts_feed.py line 701) but reels/videos are stored under media[].type=='video' — zero posts in DB have a top-level video_url field. Result: the endpoint ALWAYS returns [] even when video_progress docs exist with position>3 & completed=false. Reproduced: logged in as newtest@bruno.com, POST /api/posts/{id}/progress {position:6,duration:60} on a reel → 200 saved. Immediately GET /api/posts/continue-watching → 200 [] (empty). This breaks the entire 'Continuar viendo' feature for short-form reels. FIX: change the filter to {$or:[{video_url:{$ne:null}}, {'media.type':'video'}]} (or just drop the video_url constraint — ids already come from video_progress).

ui_bugs.issue: continue-watching-reels strip and continue-watching-profile row never appear because backend returns []. Cannot verify cw-item-*, cw-dismiss, cw-open-*, cw-remove-* until backend bug is fixed.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend components depend on GET /api/posts/continue-watching returning items; backend always returns []. End-to-end verification impossible without a top-level video_url post.

issues: React console warning: hydration error — <span> cannot be a child of <select> / <option>. Caused by a dev-time wrapping tool injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> around <option> children of the card-lang-select <select>. Not blocking functionality (lang select works), but produces noisy warnings every render.

action_items: FIX /app/backend/routers/posts_feed.py line 701 continue-watching query: replace {"video_url": {"$ne": None}} with {"$or":[{"video_url":{"$ne":None}}, {"media.type":"video"}]} so that reels progress surfaces.
After fix, verify /reels shows continue-watching-reels strip for a user with saved progress, and /my-profile?tab=reels shows continue-watching-profile row above the grid.
(Optional) Investigate the dev wrapper that injects <span> inside the lang-select <select>/<option> on ViewCardPage — produces hydration errors.
critical_code_review_comments: posts_feed.py L701 continue_watching: filter {video_url: {$ne: null}} silently drops ALL reels. Combined with the dur check `if not p or (dur and r['position'] >= dur - 8): continue`, when p is None (post filtered out), it skips — so the user never sees anything. Hard-blocks the whole feature.
posts_feed.py L705: `dur = r.get('duration') or p.get('duration') if p else None` is parsed as `r.get('duration') or (p.get('duration') if p else None)` — fine, but worth clarifying with parens.

password_reset.py reset_password L84: on reset success, invalidates all unused tokens for the user (good). Expired-token return path (L82-83) is clean. Token hashing is sha256 (acceptable for short-lived tokens, 60min TTL).

ViewCardPage lang-select uses browser native <select> — functional but inconsistent with shadcn Select used elsewhere; also the data-ve-dynamic wrapper breaks HTML validity. Consider plain <select> without wrapper or switch to shadcn Select.

success_rate.backend: 87.5% (7/8 passed, 1 skipped due to continue-watching bug)
success_rate.frontend: 85% (OVC logos, forgot/reset UI, profile watermark, card i18n+selector all pass; continue-watching strips cannot render)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration112_pwd_cw.py (pymongo-based direct insert for reset token, requires MongoDB on localhost). TestPasswordReset passes end-to-end including password RESTORE to Test1234!. TestContinueWatching has a skipped case: `test_create_progress_then_appears` is designed to find a video post, POST progress, assert resume_position=6 & resume_pct=10, then DELETE. It skips because no post in DB has top-level video_url — ALL reels are media[].type=video. After E1 fixes the filter in posts_feed.py L701, this test should pass automatically. Frontend testids verified: ovc-attribution, ovc-attribution-inline (login), ovc-attribution-legal (/legal), login-forgot-link → /forgot-password → forgot-password-page, forgot-email-input, forgot-submit, forgot-sent; reset-password?token=bad → reset-invalid + reset-request-new. profile-watermark is on an IMG element itself (not a wrapper div) — use `img[data-testid="profile-watermark"]` or `[data-testid="profile-watermark"]` directly, NOT `[data-testid="profile-watermark"] img`. The example card /c/example-negocio hides the lang-select (uses its own ES/EN only). The real card /c/d16c2745-… shows card-lang-select with options ES/EN/PT/FR/IT, persists to localStorage key 'bruno_card_lang' and ?lang=X query param overrides.
rca of the issue: Continue-watching: posts_feed.py:701 passes {video_url:{$ne:null}} to db.posts.find, but reels are persisted as {media:[{type:'video', url:'...'}], post_type:'video'} with no top-level video_url. Count: 0 posts match this filter; 16 posts match {media.type:'video'}. Fix the query.
